subject.title: fix(whatsapp): cache bot's own outbound messages for quote metadata (#91445)

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live WhatsApp Desktop proof, or is maintainer-run proof/override acceptable for the linked reply-bubble bug?
rationale: The source-level fix is narrow and plausible, but the contributor supplied only unit-test output and explicitly lacks live proof for visible WhatsApp Desktop behavior.

options.title: Require Desktop Proof First
options.body: Ask for a redacted WhatsApp Desktop/group screenshot, recording, logs, or live transcript proving the after-fix reply bubble renders for a swipe-reply to a bot-authored message.

options.title: Accept Maintainer Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer with paired WhatsApp access can independently validate the Desktop group flow and explicitly override the contributor proof gate.

options.title: Pause Or Replace
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging, or replace it with a maintainer-tested branch, if no real WhatsApp proof can be produced.

recommendation.title: Require Desktop Proof First
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted WhatsApp Desktop/group screenshot, recording, logs, or live transcript proving the after-fix reply bubble renders for a swipe-reply to a bot-authored message.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has adjacent history in the WhatsApp echo-suppression path that makes the proof decision actionable.
